title: Pontotoc students graduating in December have until Monday to sign up for ICC orientation
excerpt: ICC’s sign-up form lists a 1 p.m. session in Tupelo on Dec. 2 and another in Fulton on Dec. 3. Students starting in January can choose either campus.
locality: Pontotoc County is in Itawamba Community College’s supporting district. Sessions are in Tupelo and Fulton, Mississippi.

facts.statement: Pontotoc County high school seniors who graduate in December and plan to start at Itawamba Community College in January have through Monday, Nov. 30, to register for orientation. The college requires these incoming students to attend one session. Pontotoc is one of the five counties in ICC’s district.
facts.evidence: Both live registration rows show the registration period ending 11/30/2026. The dated college notice describes who must attend. The handbook lists the five counties.

facts.identities: Itawamba Community College and high school seniors graduating in December who plan to enroll in spring 2027.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County high school seniors who graduate in December and plan to start at Itawamba Community College in January have through Monday, Nov. 30, to register for orientation. The college requires these incoming students to attend one session. Pontotoc is one of the five counties in ICC’s district.

The live registration form offers two choices. The Tupelo session is Wednesday, Dec. 2, at 1 p.m. in the Academic and Student Center, 2176 South Eason Blvd. The Fulton session is Thursday, Dec. 3, at 1 p.m. in the W.O. Benjamin Fine Arts Center on the campus at 602 West Hill Street. Students may choose whichever session works for them, even if they will take classes on the other campus.

Students need to apply for admission before signing up. ICC offers orientation free of charge and encourages students to send in their ACT scores ahead of time. Parents or guardians may attend. Students can build their spring class schedule and get their student ID photo taken during the visit.

Families can use the college’s registration form linked below to choose a campus. ICC sends a confirmation email with a code students can use to change their registration. Questions about a session can go to orientation@iccms.edu.
